items.title_en: Crocodile head found in man’s luggage during airport screening
items.title_zh: 机场安检时，男子行李中发现鳄鱼头
items.summary_en: If convicted, the croc smuggler could face a fine of between $23,200 and $232,000 or a six-month to one-year stint in prison.
items.summary_zh: 如果罪名成立，鳄鱼走私犯可能面临 23,200 美元至 232,000 美元的罚款或六个月至一年的监禁。
items.source: New York Post Weird But True
